context: A boss reviews a CSR / regional report
purpose: Teach: 地盤/町長/奨学/実名/前編/メーター/パッチ/ならびに

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 地盤の強化、地元町長との会合、設定しろ。
lines.en: Strengthen the foundation — set up that meeting with the local mayor.
lines.style: Sharp, clipped diction. Expectant pause after the dash. No wasted syllables. Direct eye contact, shoulder slightly forward. The tone of someone accustomed to immediate compliance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。奨学金事業、報告書の前編と後編に分けます。
lines.en: Yes. We'll split the scholarship project report into two sections.
lines.style: Steady, professional cadence. Slight nod with the opening affirmative. Measured delivery — showing competence through clarity, not speed. Feet planted.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 記者懇談、実名公表が前提だ。
lines.en: Press conference — real names go public. That's non-negotiable.
lines.style: Firm anchor on 「real names」. No inflection that invites debate. Sits back slightly — the decision is already made. Weight of authority without harshness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 計測機器のメーター、ならびに最新パッチ、現場に展開済みです。
lines.en: The measurement equipment and latest patches are already deployed in the field.
lines.style: Even, factual tone. Slight emphasis on 「already」 — showing readiness without self-congratulation. Matter-of-fact delivery. Brief pause before the period, like closing a file.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Final word of approval. Slight exhale on 「Good」 — satisfied. Stands or adjusts to leave. Tone closes the conversation cleanly but not coldly. Brief and complete.
